consequence.statement: The 'route' label in request metrics will no longer reflect label names; metric queries and dashboards using this label may need verification.

original.statement: Request metrics' "route" label no longer reflects label names in Loki 3.0.0.

decision.reason: [ev-df7e89106890] is a bug-fix changelog line saying the "route" label on request metrics no longer reflects label names. That changes the metric's label values, but the excerpt does not say anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. So behavior-change (review), with a note to check queries and dashboards that use this label, is the strongest kind the evidence supports. The medium severity is not stated in the evidence, which is why confidence is low.
